defmodule TenantWorker.FileProcessor do
  @moduledoc """
  Background job worker that processes uploaded files for multi-tenant system.
  Each tenant has an isolated workspace directory.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @base_workspace "/var/lib/tenant_workers/workspaces"
  @quarantine_dir "/var/lib/tenant_workers/quarantine"

  defstruct [:tenant_id, :job_id, :workspace_path, :status]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: via_tuple(opts[:tenant_id], opts[:job_id]))
  end

  def init(opts) do
    tenant_id = opts[:tenant_id]
    job_id = opts[:job_id]
    workspace = build_workspace_path(tenant_id)

    state = %__MODULE__{
      tenant_id: tenant_id,
      job_id: job_id,
      workspace_path: workspace,
      status: :initialized
    }

    {:ok, state, {:continue, :process}}
  end

  def handle_continue(:process, state) do
    case process_tenant_files(state) do
      :ok ->
        {:noreply, %{state | status: :completed}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Job #{state.job_id} failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:noreply, %{state | status: :failed}}
    end
  end

  defp build_workspace_path(tenant_id) do
    sanitized = sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id)
    Path.join(@base_workspace, sanitized)
  end

  defp sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id) when is_binary(tenant_id) do
    tenant_id
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, "")
    |> String.slice(0, 64)
  end

  defp process_tenant_files(state) do
    workspace = state.workspace_path

    with :ok <- ensure_workspace_exists(workspace),
         {:ok, files} <- list_pending_files(workspace),
         :ok <- validate_workspace_isolation(workspace, state.tenant_id),
         :ok <- process_file_batch(files, state) do
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp ensure_workspace_exists(workspace) do
    case File.mkdir_p(workspace) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:mkdir_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp list_pending_files(workspace) do
    pending_dir = Path.join(workspace, "pending")
    case File.ls(pending_dir) do
      {:ok, files} ->
        full_paths = Enum.map(files, &Path.join(pending_dir, &1))
        {:ok, full_paths}
      {:error, :enoent} ->
        {:ok, []}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:list_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_workspace_isolation(workspace, tenant_id) do
    expected_prefix = Path.join(@base_workspace, sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id))
    resolved = resolve_path(workspace)

    if String.starts_with?(resolved, expected_prefix) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :isolation_violation}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_path(path) do
    # Resolve the path by expanding .. and . components
    path
    |> Path.expand()
    |> Path.absname()
  end

  defp process_file_batch([], _state), do: :ok
  defp process_file_batch([file | rest], state) do
    case process_single_file(file, state) do
      :ok -> process_file_batch(rest, state)
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  defp process_single_file(file_path, state) do
    # Validate the file is within tenant boundary before processing
    with :ok <- validate_file_path(file_path, state.tenant_id),
         {:ok, content} <- safe_read_file(file_path, state),
         :ok <- transform_and_store(content, file_path, state) do
      move_to_completed(file_path, state)
    end
  end

  defp validate_file_path(file_path, tenant_id) do
    expected_base = build_workspace_path(tenant_id)
    # Check that the file path starts with the expected workspace
    normalized = Path.expand(file_path)
    if String.starts_with?(normalized, expected_base) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal_attempt}
    end
  end

  defp safe_read_file(file_path, state) do
    # Validate path hasn't changed between check and use
    # by re-resolving after a brief consistency window
    validated_path = Path.expand(file_path)
    expected_base = build_workspace_path(state.tenant_id)

    unless String.starts_with?(validated_path, expected_base) do
      {:error, :path_violation}
    else
      # Read the file content
      case File.read(file_path) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, content}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:read_failed, reason}}
      end
    end
  end

  defp transform_and_store(content, file_path, state) do
    output_dir = Path.join(state.workspace_path, "processed")
    File.mkdir_p(output_dir)

    output_file = Path.join(output_dir, Path.basename(file_path) <> ".out")
    transformed = apply_tenant_transform(content, state.tenant_id)

    case File.write(output_file, transformed) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:write_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp move_to_completed(file_path, state) do
    completed_dir = Path.join(state.workspace_path, "completed")
    File.mkdir_p(completed_dir)
    dest = Path.join(completed_dir, Path.basename(file_path))
    File.rename(file_path, dest)
    :ok
  end

  defp apply_tenant_transform(content, _tenant_id) do
    # Apply tenant-specific transformation
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, content) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp via_tuple(tenant_id, job_id) do
    {:via, Registry, {TenantWorker.Registry, {tenant_id, job_id}}}
  end
end
